limits.highdim_tree: cKDTree is exact but k-d trees degenerate in high dimension on dense data: ~5-16 s/step at n=10k x 128D (still the ONLY feasible path there - exact needs ~100 GB).  High-dim indexed flow ceiling is ~10^4; the 2D/3D grid (the live daemon's geometry) flows 10^5+.
limits.grid_numpy_only: the grid needs numpy only; the tree lazily imports scipy and falls back to exact all-pairs on ImportError.
limits.still_one_machine: internet-scale flow here is a single 31.7 GB box (like T20/T55g); distributing it across machines remains unbuilt.
